verdict.rationale: Financial Connections documents API access to balances, ownership and transaction history. It also lists an agent use case (agent-powered spending analysis, balance and transaction monitoring). That suggests the data is meant to be consumed programmatically, but the pack never shows the response format, schemas, or any enrichment, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 at every candidate path. Missing for 10: evidence of structured JSON response shapes, published or machine-readable schemas, transaction enrichment (categorization, merchant cleanup), and hands-on corroboration that agents can reason over the data without parsing heuristics.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the data comes back agent-consumable — clean structured JSON, documented schemas, and enrichment an automated financial workflow can reason over without heuristic parsing
